content.title: Alkermes (ALKS) Is Up 6.6% After FDA Breakthrough Tag for Narcolepsy Drug Alixorexton

The designation underscores alixorexton’s potential to improve on existing narcolepsy type 1 treatments and could accelerate development of Alkermes’ broader orexin agonist franchise across multiple sleep disorders.
